steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: The meds are in the underground warehouse, sir.

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: As you instructed, we imitated them, set up a bomb, caused a little bit of chaos, and got the stuff.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Good...

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: You don't look happy, sir.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: We need to get rid of the stuff... It's hard to not leave a trail, even if we change the packaging and sell it on the black market.

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: You think it'll get tracked down?

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: I got word that Rhodes Island sent someone with an... atypical background to make the delivery.

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: I noticed. The man looked familiar...

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: But old Pancho is in jail, and his people are scattered. Just being his son won't carry much influence.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Not necessarily. Someone from the city council let slip that Candela is looking for a successor, and the kid is a candidate.

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: But I thought Pancho and Candela...

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Candela cares more about ability than a personal grudge.

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: What can we do?

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Reynell's secretary shared some resources with us the last time he came by.

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: Yes... a few shops and warehouses.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Wasn't there a warehouse that belonged to a pharmaceutical company?

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: One box of meds more or less won't catch their attention.

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: You mean, pin it on Reynell?

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: That's not how I would put it. They came asking for our help. It's only natural that we asked for something in return.

steps.name: Mayor's Bodyguard
steps.text: Apologies for keeping you waiting, Señor Ernesto.

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: No problemo, I just got here.

steps.name: Mayor's Bodyguard
steps.text: Excuse me, one...

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: I got your drink, Señor Burke. A double, right?

steps.name: Mayor's Bodyguard
steps.text: I'm glad you still remember what I like, after so much time away.

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: Our time together was much longer.

steps.name: Waiter
steps.text: Here's your coffee.

steps.name: Mayor's Bodyguard
steps.text: Thanks. Mm... everything is just right.

steps.name: Mayor's Bodyguard
steps.text: After you left, there was no one who could take care of things like you could. Young people these days...

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: Have patience. You can change quickly in an environment like that.

steps.name: Mayor's Bodyguard
steps.text: By the way, Lady Candela wanted me to give you this document.

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: Document? Does she want me to do something for her?

steps.name: Mayor's Bodyguard
steps.text: No, it's what you're looking for.

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: I haven't even said why I'm here today.

steps.name: Mayor's Bodyguard
steps.text: Lady Candela knows the exact moment that you entered Dossoles. She knows that your shipment was stolen, and that you're anxious to get it back.

steps.name: Mayor's Bodyguard
steps.text: This is a record of all unusual traffic and cargo movement, including locations and persons involved.

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: I don't know how I can thank her.

steps.name: Mayor's Bodyguard
steps.text: No need for thanks, just don't forget us.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: *cough* *cough*...

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: There's more dust here than cargo.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: What's your mission, Ela?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: The stuff here has been stuck in the warehouse for the past six months, with only a single watchman keeping an eye on it.

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: That's like an invitation for people to help themselves.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Yes, Miłosz says there are reports of stolen goods every day.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Are we tracking down where they went?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: No, it's normal for stuff to go out, but yesterday the watchman got a call to expect a delivery of medicine.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Miłosz is suspicious and wants us to investigate.

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: Hostile intent?

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: Hard to say. I don't know what they would want with a warehouse like this.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Maybe Miłosz just wanted an excuse to get you and Shuhrat out of the way now that he finally has time to get something done with Reynell.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: All he needs to do is ask, and I won't go within a kilometer of either of them.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: You really don't like him, do you?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: I just don't like having to watch him play golf on the balcony every day.

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: At least he kept his promise to behave.

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: This is where the clues from the document lead, but...

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: But it's just an old run-down warehouse.

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: There's a shipment of medicine coming to the warehouse in a bit. Let's see if it's the one we're looking for.

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: Only one watchman at the warehouse. No threat.

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: Once the truck comes in, Tecno is going to turn off the security systems and let us go in to check it out.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Well, we still have to wait...

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (Yawns)

steps.name: Warehouse Watchman
steps.text: *yawn* Sleepy...

steps.name: Warehouse Watchman
steps.text: When is that shipment going to arrive?

steps.name: Warehouse Watchman
steps.text: I can't believe they're actually sending someone to inspect it. What for? The weather is so good, I just want to find a beach to lie down on, have a cup of coffee, listen to a song or two.

steps.name: Warehouse Watchman
steps.text: Dancing a soundless tango at night♪

steps.name: Warehouse Watchman
steps.text: Where's the CD? Ah.

steps.name: Sound from Headphones
steps.text: Dancing a soundless tango at night♪

steps.name: Sound from Headphones
steps.text: I can't see your face, only the warmth of your hand♪

steps.name: Warehouse Watchman
steps.text: Now this is life.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: (He's not even trying...)

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: (If you want to sleep so badly, I'll lend you a hand.)

steps.name: Warehouse Watchman
steps.text: Oomph...

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: That was easy. Let's see, where are the controls?

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: I thought there was just one manager. Why are there four people here? Who are they?

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: The security systems are down. I have good news and bad news. The good news is that we know those meds are the ones we're looking for.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: The bad news is that Reynell's bodyguards are here. Four of them, all in the warehouse.

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: I thought nobody ever came here.

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: Well, we've got a disadvantage in numbers... can you cut the lights, Tecno? Arleta and I might be able to sneak in under the cover of darkness.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Sure, I could try...

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: It's off.

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: Alright, we're moving.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Well, this guy knows how to live alright. Music and coffee... is that this year's crop?

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: (Sniffs)

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: It smells good…

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Ouch! Too hot!

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Shoot, spilled it all over the keyboard.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Where's a napkin when you need it?!
She stops at the sound of springs pushing a plastic cover open.
She hastily lifts her arm and sees an indicating light glowing green next to the keyboard. Below it is a tag that reads—
'Broadcasting.'

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: When is it coming?

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Don't worry, we have time.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: I guess that's normal for an old warehouse like this.

steps.name: Sound from Loudspeakers
steps.text: Dancing a soundless tango at night♪

steps.name: Sound from Loudspeakers
steps.text: I can't see your face, only the warmth of your hand♪

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Fuze, check out the control room.

steps.name: Sound from Loudspeakers
steps.text: In a dark corner♪

steps.name: Sound from Loudspeakers
steps.text: You step on my toes, but I'm head over heels♪

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Shouldn't have drank that stupid cup of coffee!

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: (Someone's coming...)

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: (I need to hide.)

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: Excuse me?

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: The watchman has been knocked out. There are signs of sabotage in the security and lighting systems.

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: Someone has infiltrated the warehouse.

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: They spilled coffee and pressed the wrong button... not a professional, from the looks of it.

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: I'll try to get the lights back up.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: (Looks like Ernesto isn't in yet. Got to put you to sleep too then, big guy.)

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: (Oh, he's fast!)

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: A kid?
Fuze is shocked by the figure leaping out of the darkness, not just because of her small size, but also because her punch was so fast that it was all he could do to block it.
He grabs the girl's wrist after a few exchanges and attempts to restrain her, but quickly realizes that things will not be so easy.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Not so fast!

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: What?! This kid's stronger than a grown man!

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: I'm not a kid!
The girl struggles free of Fuze's grasp and stomps on his toes.
Before he has a chance to feel the pain, the girl launches a spinning kick to his face.

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: Oof—

steps.name: Sound from Loudspeakers
steps.text: Walking on the streets, we let each other's hands go♪

steps.name: Sound from Loudspeakers
steps.text: Far away you go, never seen again♪

steps.name: Sound from Loudspeakers
steps.text: I'm left alone, searching in the dark♪

steps.name: Sound from Loudspeakers
steps.text: Oh, the silent, unfinished tango♪

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: (Whisper) Stay close.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (Whisper) Alright.
The pair sneak forward silently along the wall, not realizing that another group is doing the same a short distance away.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: (Whisper) Fuze?! He's not answering.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: (Whisper) Should we look for him?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: (Whisper) No, I'll go. You wait here for the truck. There must be more than one infiltrator.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: (Whisper) Be aware that we can't use lights if someone is lying in wait. We'd be sitting ducks.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: (Whisper) Do you want to use my night vision goggles?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: (Whisper) You hold on to it. I'll be careful.
Ela crouches down, clutching her gun, feeling her way in the darkness.

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: (Damn... where did Arleta go? I told her to stay close.)

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: (It's just so hard to do anything in the dark.)

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: (Was it this way? I might have taken a wrong turn. There shouldn't be another corner.)

steps.name: Sound from Loudspeakers
steps.text: So many times, brushing past each other♪

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: (There shouldn't have been a corner here! Not this way!)

steps.name: Sound from Loudspeakers
steps.text: So much searching, so much lost♪

steps.name: Sound from Loudspeakers
steps.text: Maybe we'll see each other again, at the next corner♪

steps.name: Ela & Tequila
steps.text: (I hope not.)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (Whisper) Ernesto?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (Uh oh, I lost him.)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Who's there?!

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: (Whisper) Did the girl not realize she was walking in circles around the same wall?

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: (Whisper) Not everyone has night vision. Say, I think I've seen her before.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: (Whisper) She was in that art community yesterday... should we leave her here?

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: (Whisper) I think her friends will come for her. I'll wait.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: (Whisper) Alright, I'll look elsewhere.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: (Mm... he's heavy.)

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: (I should have stuffed you in the cupboard with the other poor bastard.)

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: (Why would people from that neighborhood be here? This doesn't make sense.)

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: (What's that noise?)

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: (Hm?)
Doc holds his breath and reaches for his weapon. Auditory senses are sharpened in darkness. The dragging sound grows ever closer.

steps.name: Sound from Loudspeakers
steps.text: So many times, brushing past each other♪

steps.name: Sound from Loudspeakers
steps.text: So much searching, so much lost♪

steps.name: Sound from Loudspeakers
steps.text: Maybe we'll see each other again, at the next corner♪

steps.name: Tecno & Doc
steps.text: Freeze!
Their surprised exclamations send the warehouse into a frenzy.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Doc?!

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Gustave?!

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: Tecno?!

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Well, you can blame your bad luck!

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: What is that?

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Arts flash! Get to cover, Ela!

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: Wait, Tecno, don't do it here—

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: No wrong moves, girl! I've got your friend here!

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: Oh no, they've got Arleta!

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Hmph, we have a hostage too.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Shuhrat!
The only light in the darkness is from Tecno's Arts, not bright enough to illuminate the whole warehouse, but just enough for everyone to see each other's faces.
Gazes cross and scan around, reading the same thing on the assembled faces—

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: (Whisper) Well, this is awkward... how did we end up here?

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: Maybe we can exchange hostages and each go our own way?

steps.name: Tecno & Ela
steps.text: Wait!

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: What are you doing here?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: We have to find out who's been using this warehouse for smuggling. What about you, girl?

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Looking for the meds we lost.

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: We've already said we didn't steal the meds.

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: Really? Then what are you doing here?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: I told you, we're trying to find out who's smuggling stuff into this warehouse. What about you?

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: I said, this is where our meds are!

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: You people are just impossible!
Hey, anybody home? Your stuff's here!
Man, all the way out in the middle of nowhere...

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: So... if we all want to know what's up with that shipment of meds, why don't we ask the guy who's delivering it?
